description: This file defines a mock class 'OpenCDMSystemMock' for unit testing purposes, inheriting from 'OpenCDMSystem'. It uses Google Test's mocking framework to mock various methods related to DRM system operations, such as creating sessions, retrieving hashes, and deleting stores.
